data.exact_reserve_text: In addition to a low incidence of catastrophe losses, the year benefited from a significant favourable prior year reserve development within the Marine, Energy and long-tail inward reinsurance portfolios, together with better than expected attritional development on International Property binders.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate opened 2015 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,861.8m. Using the available claims development information (only a net claims development triangle was disclosed), net prior year development amounted to a small adverse movement of approximately GBP 5.64m (a net strengthening of reserves, ~0.30% of opening gross reserves). Management commentary highlights significant favourable prior year reserve development in Marine, Energy and long-tail inward reinsurance portfolios and favourable attritional development on International Property binders; however no gross prior year movement figure was provided, so the net-triangle-derived figure above has been used.
raw_causal_phrases: significant favourable prior year reserve development within the Marine, Energy and long-tail inward reinsurance portfolios
better than expected attritional development on International Property binders

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement figure was provided. A net claims development triangle (net of reinsurance) was available and used to compute prior year development (+GBP 5.64m strengthening). This is NET of reinsurance - no gross PYD figure available in the notes. Management narrative describes favourable prior-year development in certain portfolios, which may indicate gross releases not visible in net triangle. Triangle contains an aggregate "2010 and prior" column which was excluded per rules.
